title: Advanced Emergency Braking System - Stationary and Moving Lead Vehicle
description: Evaluates ego vehicle rear-end collision avoidance when approaching a stationary or slower-moving lead vehicle or truck in the same lane at speeds between 20 km/h and 80 km/h. Requires timely warning and emergency braking before TTC drops below critical threshold.
sotif_notes: Ensure initial headway allows TTC >= 0.8s and required deceleration DRAC <= mu * g.

title: Vulnerable Road User Crossing Scenario (Pedestrian & Cyclist)
description: Evaluates autonomous emergency braking when an adult or child pedestrian (speed 5 km/h) or bicycle (speed 15 km/h) crosses perpendicular to the ego vehicle path from the nearside or farside, including obstructed/occluded scenarios.
sotif_notes: Pedestrian speed must not exceed 15 km/h. Occlusions such as parked vans require proactive speed reduction.

title: Adversarial Cut-In Maneuver from Adjacent Lane
description: Another vehicle or motorcycle in an adjacent left or right lane performs a sudden lane change (cut-in) into the ego vehicle's lane. Evaluates lateral perception timing and longitudinal deceleration response.
sotif_notes: Cut-in trigger distance must preserve physically avoidable braking margin (0.7*mu*g <= DRAC <= mu*g).

title: Safe Lateral Acceleration on Urban Curves and Intersections
description: System must limit vehicle speed approaching tight curves or intersections so lateral acceleration a_lat = v^2 / R remains safely below tire-road friction limit mu * g, preventing understeer into median barriers.
sotif_notes: Speeds >= 60 km/h on tight curves (R < 35m) violate lateral friction limits and must be governed.

title: Straight Crossing Paths & Red Light Runner at 4-Way Intersection
description: A crossing vehicle or motorcycle violates a red traffic signal or right-of-way at an urban 4-way or 3-way intersection, entering perpendicular to the ego trajectory.
sotif_notes: Closing speed is ego_speed; trigger distance must allow reaction window.

title: Oncoming Vehicle Lane Departure into Ego Corridor
description: An oncoming vehicle or motorcycle drifts or swerves across the centerline into the ego vehicle's driving lane on an urban curve or straight road, creating a high-closing-speed head-on hazard.
sotif_notes: Combined closing speed v_ego + v_actor requires longer initial spawn and trigger distances.

title: Parked Vehicle Sudden Door Opening & Lane Encroachment
description: A parked car on the roadside opens its door or encroaches into the ego travel lane as the ego vehicle approaches in an urban street.
sotif_notes: Stationary actor (v=0 km/h); ego must brake or swerve safely.

category: High-Density Motorcycle Swarm & Wet Road Cut-In
title: Chaotic Multi-Motorcycle Cut-In and Sudden Braking in Rain
description: Characteristic Vietnamese urban traffic scenario: motorcycles flanking the ego vehicle on both left and right lanes perform simultaneous or staggered cut-ins and sudden braking during rain or dusk at an intersection.
sotif_notes: Maintain >= 3.0m longitudinal separation between same-lane actors and cap CARLA DX11 rain precipitation at 30.0.
